text: Would you let your AI interview go public? Anthropic has launched a study in which an AI interviewer asks Claude users what they want from AI. Afterward, participants can choose whether their full answers are published. Public responses could help others study the technology's effects. But they may also reveal personal details that identify a speaker, even without a name. The study has no findings yet, and Claude users are not a representative public sample. A public copy may persist after removal. Read the privacy choices before sharing. Subscribe on YouTube at New Horizons underscore twenty-one, and like and follow on Instagram.
